task: binary classification: mammalian-cell cytotoxicity probability in [0, 1], conditioned on assay cell type
architecture: 4-fold ensemble (mean of sigmoid outputs); BiLSTM + self-attention over per-residue ESM2 embeddings, cross-attended against a global sequence embedding, plus nn.Embedding(7, 16) over cell_type concatenated with the length feature before the head
cell_type_to_id: 7 cell types: DBAASP_no_cytotoxicity_hit, DRAMP_aggregate (default), Human PBMC, HEK, HaCat, HMEC-1, skin fibroblasts
training_data: 21028 peptides -> 14560 after CD-HIT 90%; 161 cytotoxic (119 DRAMP_aggregate, 31 HaCaT, 11 other) downsampled to a balanced 322; 64-row held-out test, 4-fold StratifiedGroupKFold
hyperparameter_search: 32 configs x 4 folds, best mean val AUPRC 0.9138
